title: Agent Orchestration & Human-in-the-Loop
description: Implement stateful agent workflows, checkpoints, approval flows, and bounded execution.

data.text: Implement stateful agent workflows with checkpoints for recovery, human approval for consequential actions, bounded retries and timeouts for safety.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Durable background work for long tasks
data.takeaway: Agent orchestration requires guardrails. Implement checkpoints, approvals, and bounds for safe autonomous execution.
